stem.text: Which statement about sucrose loading into companion cells and then into the phloem sieve tube element is **not** correct?

A.text: Hydrogen ions and sucrose molecules move into the companion cells using a carrier protein.

B.text: Hydrogen ions are pumped out of the companion cells by active transport.

C.text: Sucrose molecules are carried into the companion cells down the concentration gradient for sucrose.

D.text: Sucrose molecules move from a companion cell into the sieve tubes of the phloem through plasmodesmata.
